title: Automate changelog and onboard aurora-spark-13b v1.1 (perf profiles + metadata)
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: Canonical onboarding for aurora-spark-13b v1.1 including standardized perf profiles, model metadata, and automated changelog/release-note generation. This PR bundles three pieces: 1) model metadata (manifests + manifests schema compliance) for aurora-spark-13b v1.1 so the serving runtime and catalog can pick up versioned attributes (vocab/ctx, tokenizer hints, supported quantization profiles); 2) performance profiles generated from lab runs (p95/p99 latency, throughput across GPU classes, memory footprints) and lightweight perf test harness integration; 3) automation to append a generated changelog entry to the registry CHANGELOG.md and to emit a release note snippet used by the release pipeline. Implementation notes: metadata lives under models/aurora-spark/1.1/ with model.json and profiles/*.yaml; perf profiles were produced by the benchmark-lab harness and normalized to our perf-profile schema; changelog automation adds a new script tools/registry_changelog.py and a GH action .github/workflows/auto-changelog.yml that runs on push to main for new model manifests and opens a draft release note. Checklist: [x] model manifest schema validated with schema-validator action [x] perf profiles reviewed by perf owner [x] changelog automation tested in forked workflow [x] docs example updated (docs/models/aurora-spark.md). Backwards compatibility: metadata additions are additive and use safe keys; perf profile spec version bumped (v2) with compatibility shim included.
